  PROBLEM: The outer gate `if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then`, whose else branch at line 3658 prints "No conflict resolution changes to commit", ignores MERGE_HEAD. A merge in progress with the index equal to HEAD and no untracked or modified entries would skip the commit and not write CONFLICT_RESOLVED.
  WHY: The reviewer could not show this is reachable in the review job, because untracked workflow artifacts and `.ai/` files normally keep the gate true. It is hardening only. Suggested fix: `if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
